_comment: Template for RVT (Recurrent Vision Transformer) training - detection only

_key_flags.output_format: rvt - RVT-compatible format with event_representations_v2/ and labels_v2/
_key_flags.use_raw_events: true - Store raw events for representation at training time
_key_flags.event_representation: stacked_histogram (default for RVT), or vtei, voxel_grid, etc.
_key_flags.filter_classes: List of class names to filter (e.g. ['person'])
